en_title: Ghost of Yotei Sales Lag Behind Tsushima but Are Still Strong on PS5, Analyst Estimates Show
cn_title: 分析：《羊蹄山之魂》销量落后前作
subtitle: 收入差距不大
opus_summary: 分析师估算，《羊蹄山之魂》首年售出约540万份，虽不及前作同期近700万份，但两作收入接近。相关数据尚未获索尼确认，分析师强调本作绝非失败之作。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Yōtei sales appear to be trailing behind Ghost of Tsushima , but that doesn't mean it's not still pulling big numbers on PlayStation 5.
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》的销量似乎落后于《对马岛之魂》，但这并不代表它在PS5上的销量不够亮眼。

paragraphs.en: That's according to Alinea Analytics head of marketing analysis Rhys Elliott, who shared data related to Sucker Punch Productions' 2025 sequel on X/Twitter . Although this is sales information that has yet to be confirmed by Sony, it may still give us a peek behind the curtain at how Ghost of Yōtei has fared on PS5.
paragraphs.cn: 这一判断来自Alinea Analytics营销分析负责人Rhys Elliott。他在X上分享了Sucker Punch Productions这部2025年续作的相关数据。虽然这些销量信息尚未得到索尼确认，但或许仍能让我们一窥《羊蹄山之魂》在PS5上的表现。

paragraphs.en: The result: Sucker Punch's action follow-up has done well in its first year, even if it hasn't quite managed to pass up its predecessor. Alinea's analysis puts Ghost of Yōtei sales at about 5.4 million units, generating $407 million in revenue so far. Highlights from that update put the physical slice at a notable 36.8%, while PlayStation Store discounts remain largely few and far between.
paragraphs.cn: 分析结果显示，Sucker Punch这部动作游戏续作虽然未能超越前作，但首年表现依然不错。Alinea估算，《羊蹄山之魂》迄今售出约540万份，创造了4.07亿美元(约合人民币27亿元)收入。这次更新的数据还显示，实体版占比达到值得关注的36.8%，而游戏在PlayStation Store的打折次数仍然很少。

paragraphs.en: Around 500,000 copies were sold in Q3 2026 alone. Alinea also reported that 50,000 players have picked up the digital Complete Edition – which comes with new content, including the recently released Echoes of Sekigahara expansion – in the two weeks since PlayStation launched it as a replacement for the digital base game. With the analysis estimating that around 6% of its existing base returned to play the new content, it seems Ghost of Yōtei is going strong – but there is more to the story.
paragraphs.cn: 仅2026年第三季度，本作就售出了约50万份。Alinea还指出，PlayStation推出数字完整版、用其替代数字标准版后，两周内已有5万名玩家购买。完整版包含新内容，其中包括最近推出的《Echoes of Sekigahara》扩展内容。分析估计，约6%的现有玩家回归体验了新内容。《羊蹄山之魂》似乎依然势头强劲，不过，情况还不止于此。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Tsushima, which launched in a market still coming to grips with pandemic lockdowns in July 2020, had generated about $418 million by the same point in its lifespan, Elliott added in a follow-up post. Factoring in Yōtei's base price of $70 vs Tsushima's base price of $60, as well as any discounts that followed, the latter is estimated to have sold almost 7 million copies by this point.
paragraphs.cn: Elliott在后续帖子中补充，《对马岛之魂》于2020年7月发售，当时市场仍在适应疫情封锁；该作在发售后的相同时间内，已创造约4.18亿美元(约合人民币28亿元)收入。考虑到《羊蹄山之魂》的标准售价为70美元(约合人民币468元)，《对马岛之魂》为60美元(约合人民币401元)，以及两作后续的折扣，估计《对马岛之魂》同期销量接近700万份。

paragraphs.en: That puts Tsushima moving at a much faster pace in terms of raw units sold, but there is more at play here, especially considering revenue is almost neck and neck.
paragraphs.cn: 单看售出份数，《对马岛之魂》的销售速度要快得多。但还需要考虑其他因素，尤其是两作收入几乎不相上下。

paragraphs.en: How do Ghost of Yotei’s revenues compare to Tsushima’s?
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》的收入与《对马岛之魂》相比如何？

paragraphs.en: Our estimates (@alineaanalytics) show that Yotei has generated revenue of $407M. At this point, launch-aligned, Ghost of Tsushima had made $418M, so about 3% more.
paragraphs.cn: 我们（@alineaanalytics）估算，《羊蹄山之魂》已创造4.07亿美元(约合人民币27亿元)收入。按发售后经过的时间对齐比较，《对马岛之魂》同期收入为4.18亿美元(约合人民币28亿元)，高出约3%。

paragraphs.en: As Yotei costs $70, and has had just two discounts, and Tsushima was $60 at launch (and was already discounted to $45 less than three months post-launch), Tsushima had sold more copies at this point. Nearly 7M versus Yotei’s 5.4M.
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》售价为70美元(约合人民币468元)，且只打过两次折；《对马岛之魂》首发售价为60美元(约合人民币401元)，发售不到三个月就已降至45美元(约合人民币301元)。因此，《对马岛之魂》同期卖出的份数更多，接近700万份，而《羊蹄山之魂》为540万份。

paragraphs.en: This is about 26% more revenue per buyer, which is consistent with PlayStation’s goal of extracting more revenue per player.
paragraphs.cn: 也就是说，《羊蹄山之魂》每位买家带来的收入高出约26%，这与PlayStation从每位玩家身上获取更多收入的目标一致。

paragraphs.en: While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yotei’s only platform).
paragraphs.cn: 虽然两作售出份数的差距相当大，但值得注意的是，《对马岛之魂》发售后的相同时间点，市面上约有1.17亿台PS4和1,000万台PS5；相比之下，目前PS5的装机量接近1亿台，而《羊蹄山之魂》只登陆了PS5。

paragraphs.en: That said, Yotei’s revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，《羊蹄山之魂》的收入增长开始趋缓，而且比《对马岛之魂》当时更明显。不过，或许《GTA》带动的PS5新增装机量能够缓解这一趋势。

paragraphs.en: Yotei has proven to be an evergreen seller in a crowded market, shifting 1.8M copies this year ($121M in revenue) despite having just two small discounts and competing with what is one of the busiest and highest-quality release calendars … ever.
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》已证明自己能在拥挤的市场中持续畅销。今年它仅有两次小幅折扣，还要面对堪称有史以来最密集、作品质量最高的发售阵容之一，但依然售出了180万份，创造1.21亿美元(约合人民币8亿元)收入。

paragraphs.en: So yeah, anyone who says that Ghost of Yotei is a flop is flat-out wrong.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，没错，任何说《羊蹄山之魂》失败了的人，都完全错了。

paragraphs.en: (Note: the Y-axis starts at $392M. Otherwise, the chart wouldn’t be readable, as the numbers are so close)
paragraphs.cn: （注：纵轴从3.92亿美元(约合人民币26亿元)起算。两组数字太过接近，如果不这样处理，图表就无法看清。）

paragraphs.en: "While that’s quite the gap in terms of copies, it’s worth noting that by this point in Tsushima’s lifecycle, there were about 117M PS4s and 10M PS5s in the wild, versus the nearly 100M PS5s currently out there right now (Yōtei's only platform)," Elliott explained. "That said, Yōtei's revenue is beginning to flatten more than Tsushima’s did, but perhaps the GTA-driven influx of new PS5s will soften that."
paragraphs.cn: Elliott解释道：「虽然两作售出份数的差距相当大，但值得注意的是，《对马岛之魂》发售后的相同时间点，市面上约有1.17亿台PS4和1,000万台PS5；相比之下，目前PS5的装机量接近1亿台，而《羊蹄山之魂》只登陆了PS5。」「话虽如此，《羊蹄山之魂》的收入增长开始趋缓，而且比《对马岛之魂》当时更明显。不过，或许《GTA》带动的PS5新增装机量能够缓解这一趋势。」

paragraphs.en: In other words, although Ghost of Tsushima had managed to move more copies by this point after its launch, Ghost of Yōtei is holding its own. Early estimates after the sequel's launch also had it falling in line with the original game , with Sony going on to confirm in February of this year that the follow-up "exceeded" Tsushima's sales and "significantly contributed" to its financial results for that quarter. As Elliott clarified today, "anyone who says that Ghost of Yōtei is a flop is flat-out wrong."
paragraphs.cn: 换句话说，虽然《对马岛之魂》在发售后的相同时间内卖出了更多份数，但《羊蹄山之魂》的表现依然不俗。续作发售后的早期估算也显示，其表现与前作相当。索尼随后在今年2月确认，续作销量「超过」《对马岛之魂》，并为当季财务业绩「作出了显著贡献」。正如Elliott今天澄清的那样，「任何说《羊蹄山之魂》失败了的人，都完全错了」。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Yōtei launched in October 2025 and is exclusive to PS5. IGN gave it an 8/10 review , saying, "A predictable but well-executed story takes you through Ghost of Yotei's gorgeous landscapes and satisfying, fluid action – it may not be revolutionizing open world games, but it's a great distillation of the samurai fantasy." It recently added a new armor set based on PlayStation's The Last of Us .
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》于2025年10月发售，为PS5独占游戏。IGN在评测中给出了8分（满分10分），评价道：「故事虽在意料之中，却讲得扎实，带领玩家领略《羊蹄山之魂》的壮丽风光，体验流畅爽快的动作战斗。它或许没有为开放世界游戏带来革命，但出色地呈现了人们对武士的幻想。」本作最近还加入了一套以PlayStation旗下《最后生还者》为主题的新护甲。
